<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Women&#x27;s reservation bill fails:</strong> The Constitutional Amendment Bill aimed at providing reservation for women in the Lok Sabha and State Assemblies has failed to pass, sparking renewed debate over the representation of women in Parliament.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxPSTVKRHVGUXlhNjVqNEczYkNpd1NvbmRYOU5Fd2RIZjV3OHBob0owSzh3LVRXdUVqSDNVZTgtbVZlUG8ybS1wallfSVdTeTRtNENIU0lwV3piczdxV2NEVmE0WC1GSTQyMjR4dkNPb1pqblB2SzNHQjZBRWVXZHpPZXE2bVlQc3NGNEFJVU1NUHJMMFFqSkdRUVFFMGZNRUkzSTc0LXphM1JaLXM?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Administrative reshuffle:</strong> Former Uttar Pradesh Deputy Chief Minister Dinesh Sharma has been appointed as the Lieutenant Governor of Andaman and Nicobar Islands amidst a broader wave of government appointments.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Judicial policy changes:</strong> The Supreme Court Collegium, led by the Chief Justice of India, has approved a new policy for the early transfer of High Court Chief Justices to streamline judicial administration.</li>
  <li><strong>Public order and infrastructure:</strong> The Supreme Court has ruled that public roads cannot be obstructed for religious activities, emphasizing the need to balance civic rights with public convenience.</li>
  <li><strong>Election Commission action:</strong> The Election Commission of India has barred former Congress MLA Aassan Maulaana from contesting elections for a period of three years.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a></span></li>
</ul>
